title: Entropy-Bounded Empiricism: Core Principles
abstract: Foundational methodology paper for Entropy-Bounded Empiricism (EBE). Defines the S-axis (physical regime hierarchy: Low-S, Mid-S, High-S), the L-axis (epistemic layer hierarchy L0-L3), and the Regime-Consistent Measurement Protocol (RCMP). Introduces regime-gating, proxy-chain transparency requirements, and epistemic degradation principles that prevent cross-regime extrapolation errors.

efc_context.regime_relevance: All regimes; defines the regime classification itself

key_results: S-axis regime hierarchy (Low-S, Mid-S, High-S) for physical scale classification
L-axis epistemic layers L0 (direct measurement) through L3 (model-dependent inference)
Regime-Consistent Measurement Protocol (RCMP) preventing cross-regime extrapolation
Regime-gating principle: claims valid only within their originating regime
Proxy-chain transparency: all inferential steps must be explicitly declared
Epistemic degradation: confidence decreases with each proxy step
